# Named-whole gizmo

`Gizmo: giz-named-whole` `LIVE`

## What it does

Puts another gizmo's bare id in `covers`, where the field names a behaviour. `ref-resolves` refuses it there and names
the form to write. No section here closes on a `Covers` line at all, so `mirrors-citations` reports the same field
again.
